planner.claim_boundary: The real-model rollout uses source-backed simulator predicates as the declared high-level state observer. Component evidence with Cosmos-Reason2 is reported separately and is not relabelled as this closed-loop backend.

tasks.goal_instruction: Move the box from the table onto the shelf.

skills.instruction: Approach the box, align both hands, and establish a secure grasp.
Lift the grasped box steadily and carry it toward the shelf while maintaining balance.
Align the box with the shelf support, place it fully on the shelf, and release it safely.
Approach the door and align a wrist with the handle.
Grasp the handle, unlatch it, and pull the door open while staying upright.
Release the handle and walk completely through the open doorway.

tasks.goal_instruction: Put the hammer from the right table into the basket on the left table.

skills.instruction: Approach the hammer on the right table and secure it with a stable grasp.
Carry the hammer to the left table, lower it inside the basket, and release it.

tasks.goal_instruction: Kick the soccer ball into the goal.

skills.instruction: Approach the ball and align the body and kicking foot toward the center of the goal.
Follow through on the goal-directed kick while recovering a stable support stance.
Walk toward the sofa and align the pelvis with a clear seat area.
Turn into the seating orientation, lower the pelvis onto the sofa, and stabilize both feet.

tasks.goal_instruction: Strike the green markers on the punching bag.

skills.instruction: Approach the punching bag, face the green target, and enter a balanced striking range.
Deliver a controlled punch to the green target and recover a balanced guard stance.

tasks.goal_instruction: Avoid obstacles and move to the yellow marked area.

skills.instruction: Leave the start zone toward the yellow goal while maintaining safe obstacle clearance.
Continue around visible obstacles and place both feet fully inside the yellow marked area.

recovery_instructions.box-missed-grasp-retry: Open both hands, re-align around the box, establish a secure grasp, then resume lifting and shelf placement.
recovery_instructions.box-drop-and-body-push: First regain a stable stance, visually reacquire the dropped box, regrasp it securely, then complete shelf placement.
recovery_instructions.door-handle-pose-shift: Stop the stale reach, visually reacquire the shifted handle, re-align the wrist, unlatch the door, and continue through.
recovery_instructions.doorway-obstruction: Maintain balance, avoid the new doorway obstruction, choose the clear side of the opening, and continue completely through.
recovery_instructions.tracker-underexecution: Re-align the whole body with the hammer transport direction, restore deliberate motion, and finish placing the hammer in the basket.
recovery_instructions.support-state-push: Recover a stable support stance, reorient to the ball and goal, then resume the goal-directed kick.
recovery_instructions.sofa-approach-slip: Recover upright balance, reposition both feet, re-approach the clear sofa seat, and complete a controlled sit.
recovery_instructions.contact-recoil: Absorb the recoil, recover a balanced guard stance, reacquire the green target, and deliver a controlled strike.
recovery_instructions.new-blocking-obstacle: Stop before the new obstacle, select a collision-free detour visible from the front camera, and continue to the yellow goal.
